query: Senior backend software engineers in the United States with strong Python and AWS experience

criteria.text: Strong Python and API development skills
Experience with microservices or distributed systems

expectation: Candidates with Python + AWS + senior tenure should score highest; those missing AWS or seniority should score lower and matchAnalysis must reflect it.

query: Frontend engineers skilled in React and TypeScript

criteria.text: Familiarity with state management (Redux, Zustand, etc.)

expectation: React/TS should be the dominant signal; a backend-only profile should score low.

query: Data scientists with machine learning and Python experience

criteria.text: Python and data analysis (pandas, scikit-learn) skills

expectation: ML + Python should drive the score; a pure data-analyst without ML should be mid/low.

query: DevOps engineers experienced with Kubernetes and CI/CD

criteria.text: CI/CD pipeline design (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI)

expectation: K8s + IaC should dominate; a generic sysadmin without containers should score lower.

query: Product managers with fintech or payments experience

criteria.text: Product management experience shipping B2B or consumer products
Fintech, banking, or payments domain experience
Experience working with engineering and design teams

expectation: PM tenure + fintech domain should score highest; a PM in an unrelated domain should be mid.

query: Technical recruiters with experience hiring software engineers

criteria.text: Experience sourcing and hiring software engineers specifically
Familiarity with ATS and sourcing tools

expectation: Tech-recruiting tenure should drive the score; a generalist HR profile should be lower.

query: Registered nurses with ICU or critical care experience

criteria.text: Experience in an acute-care hospital setting

expectation: Non-tech domain sanity check — RN + ICU should score high; a non-clinical profile should be excluded/low.

query: Accountants with CPA certification and audit experience

criteria.text: Proficiency with accounting software (QuickBooks, SAP, NetSuite)

expectation: CPA + audit should drive score; a bookkeeper without CPA should be lower and satisfied=false on the CPA criterion.
